# Midwest Industrial Brokers

> Industrial commercial real estate brokerage for Plymouth, Ann Arbor, the I-275 corridor and greater Metro Detroit, Michigan. Led by Drake Filippis, Associate Broker with Signature Associates.

## Services
- [Disposition](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/disposition/): Selling an industrial building or land? Pricing, marketing and negotiation built to bring the right buyer to the table.
- [Acquisition](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/acquisition/): Buying for your business or your portfolio. A focused search, the right questions and a clean path to closing.
- [Build-to-Suit](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/build-to-suit/): When no existing building fits. Site selection, entitlements and developer coordination for a facility designed around your operation.
- [Tenant Representation](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/tenant-representation/): Leasing warehouse, manufacturing or flex space. Search, tours and lease negotiation on your side of the table.
- [Buyer Representation](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/buyer-representation/): Owner users buying a building for their own business. Search, negotiation and closing coordination with your goals first.
- [Landlord Representation](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/landlord-representation/): Leasing an industrial building or multi tenant flex property. Marketing, tenant outreach and lease negotiation that protect your asset.
- [Investment Sales](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/investment-sales/): Buying or selling leased industrial property. Pricing, marketing and buyer outreach built around income and tenancy.

## Markets served
- [Plymouth](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/plymouth-mi/): Light manufacturing, flex and distribution space close to I-275 and M-14.
- [Ann Arbor](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/ann-arbor-mi/): Flex, research and light industrial space across Washtenaw County.
- [Livonia](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/livonia-mi/): An established industrial base with access to I-96 and I-275.
- [I-275 Corridor](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/i-275-corridor/): Plymouth, Livonia, Canton, Novi and Romulus along one north south route.
- [Metro Detroit](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/metro-detroit/): Manufacturing, warehouse and distribution space across the region.
- [Canton](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/canton-mi/): Industrial and flex space in western Wayne County off I-275.
- [Saline](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/saline-mi/): Industrial space in southern Washtenaw County near US-12 and US-23.
- [Novi](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/novi-mi/): Flex and light industrial space near I-96 and I-275.
- [Romulus](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/romulus-mi/): Warehouse and logistics space around Detroit Metro Airport.
- [Taylor](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/taylor-mi/): Downriver industrial and distribution space near I-94.
- [Ypsilanti](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/ypsilanti-mi/): Industrial space east of Ann Arbor along I-94 and US-12.
- [Dexter](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/dexter-mi/): Industrial buildings and land in western Washtenaw County.
- [Farmington](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/farmington-mi/): Flex and light industrial space near I-696, I-275 and M-5.
- [Brighton](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/brighton-mi/): Industrial space in Livingston County at I-96 and US-23.
- Coverage: Plymouth, Livonia, Canton, Novi, Farmington, Romulus, Taylor, Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti, Saline, Dexter, Brighton, Northville, Wixom, Metro Detroit

## FAQ
### How does Drake help owners sell or lease an industrial building?
Disposition starts with a walkthrough and a review of the building, the market and your goals. From there Drake builds a pricing and marketing plan, lists the property on CPIX and other industrial channels, reaches out to likely buyers or tenants, and manages tours, offers, negotiation and due diligence through closing or lease signing.

### How does an acquisition search work for owner users and investors?
It begins with a clear list of requirements, such as size, clear height, power, loading, yard, zoning, location and budget. Drake then searches listed and off market options, sets up tours, helps compare buildings side by side, and negotiates the purchase. He also helps coordinate inspections, environmental review, title and financing timing so the deal can close on schedule.

### What is a build-to-suit and when does it make sense?
A build-to-suit is a new facility designed and built around a specific user. It can make sense when no existing building meets your needs, or when your operation needs special features like heavy power, high clear height or extra loading. Drake helps with site selection, entitlements and coordination with developers and contractors, and can compare build-to-suit options with existing buildings.

### How long does it take to lease industrial space?
It depends on the size of the space, how many options fit, the condition of the building and how much work is needed before move in. A simple lease of a ready space can move quickly, while larger spaces or spaces that need improvements often take longer. Starting early gives you more choices and more negotiating room, so it is smart to reach out well before your current lease ends.

### What should I have ready before I start a search?
Helpful details include the size you need, ceiling height, number and type of loading doors, power, parking and yard needs, preferred areas, budget, and your move in date. If you are buying, it also helps to know your financing plan. Drake can help you work through any of these if you are not sure yet.

### Do you represent tenants, buyers, landlords and sellers?
Yes. Drake represents owners on disposition and leasing, and represents buyers and tenants on acquisitions and leases. On every assignment the representation is confirmed in writing at the start so everyone knows who is represented.

### Which areas do you cover?
Drake focuses on industrial property in Plymouth, Livonia, Canton, Ann Arbor, Saline, Novi, Northville, Wixom, the I-275 corridor and greater Metro Detroit. Through Signature Associates he also handles assignments in other parts of Michigan and the region.

### How do I get started?
Call Drake at (248) 941-1125, call the office at (248) 799-3161, or send a short note through the contact form on this site. Share what you need and your timing, and Drake will follow up to talk through next steps.
